mapper.select: SELECT b.bd_id, b.m_id, m.m_nickname AS author_nickname, b.bd_category, b.bd_title, b.bd_content, b.bd_view_count, b.recruit_status, b.pln_id, p.pln_title AS planner_title, b.bd_rating, b.created_at, b.updated_at FROM board b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.m_id = m.m_id LEFT JOIN planner p ON b.pln_id = p.pln_id WHERE b.bd_id = #{bdId} AND b.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert:
SELECT seq_board.CURRVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO board ( m_id, bd_category, bd_title, bd_content, bd_view_count, recruit_status, pln_id, bd_rating, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{mId}, #{bdCategory}, #{bdTitle}, #{bdContent}, 0, #{recruitStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{plnId, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{bdRating, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 0, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET bd_title = #{bdTitle}, bd_content = #{bdContent}, pln_id = #{plnId}, bd_rating = #{bdRating}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE bd_id = #{bdId}
UPDATE board SET is_deleted = 1, deleted_at = SYSDATE WHERE bd_id = #{bdId}
UPDATE board SET recruit_status = 'CLOSED', updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE bd_id = #{bdId}
